identity.realm: Fourteenth rung of the mind ladder, Spirit Severing, where the qiao vessels open and the sea deepens past the point where the cost curve has overtaken the work. His subspecies has no authored ceiling, because its qi has no organ to sit in: the fire is the body, qi passes through continuously, and every storage gate answers at once and refuses nothing. There is no gate for him to fail. There is a ladder, and he is on it.

appearance.presentation: a working body in fuel and cold rather than a dressed one; he is described as being in the room, not in front of it
appearance.age: old for a species that reproduces by fission rather than by birth, which means his age is a count of separations and not a count of years
appearance.build: a stable flame with a consistent silhouette - a core, a boundary, and a set of convection lanes that hold the shape - with no organs, no limbs in the muscular sense and no fixed mass
appearance.complexion: none; the surface reads as heat gradient, and the colour of his interior is whatever is in the fuel he is standing nearest
appearance.hair: none, and never described as none by him; a cinderkin has no surface to grow one on, and he finds the question embarrassing for other people
appearance.eyes: none used; he is a heat differential and reads the room as temperature, fuel and flow, which is why he is never painted looking at anything
appearance.palette: cold ash grey and white at the outer boundary, moving through ochre to a blue-white core, with the fuel's own colour showing through wherever he has been standing longest
appearance.attire: nothing worn and a great deal carried - a stoppered jar, a folded hide for the cold hours, and a second set of tools that are his own and are not shared
appearance.marks: a visibly thinner band along his left flank where he has separated before, kept deliberately, so that anyone who has met the other one can identify this one
appearance.bearing: economical to the point of stillness, because a lane held is mass held and a cinderkin that moves without need is a cinderkin losing shape

canon.role_in_story: The only body in the setting that can be separated from itself and have both halves continue, and the only certified practitioner whose entry has to be read twice. A cinderkin's continuity runs by fission rather than descent, so there is no such thing as a cinderkin child - there is a cinderkin who made another one. Voreth made one on purpose, at the fourteenth rung of the mind ladder, where the discipline's own description is that the self is separated from a specific attachment rather than a limb. His attachment was the second body. He is therefore the setting's only living proof that an elemental body survives its own continuity, and also the reason the office that certifies breakthroughs on this tier has a form with no box for him. He does not read, certify, survey or answer questions about other people. He is the entry, and the entry is wrong, and correcting it requires somebody to admit which half of a practitioner is the practitioner.
canon.first_appearance: First seen on the floor of the Held Hour with one hand flat on cold ash and the other extended toward a spark of himself that is going nowhere, waiting to be told which of them the office should enter.
canon.lore:
A cinderkin is not a person who burns. It is an elemental body that requires a slot in the world's elemental law to exist at all, which is why the record is full of explanations of cinderkin and almost empty of cinderkin practice. The mortal stretch of the world seats three law slots and none of them resolves to fire, so the population is present as a fact and absent as a possibility. What a cinderkin is, physically, is a stable flame with a consistent silhouette: a core, a boundary, and a set of convection lanes that hold a shape. It has no organs. It has no limbs in the muscular sense. It has no fixed mass. Its soul is the flame itself, genuinely qi-bearing, and seated nowhere - which is the whole reason its qi is entirely in transit, and why nothing can be stored in such a body and, by the same arrangement, nothing can be lost from one either.

Its reproduction is the fact this character is built on. A cinderkin does not have young; it has pressure. Under enough stress it sheds a spark, the spark finds fuel, and it re-constitutes itself as a body in its own right. Nothing about that is a metaphor and nothing about it is a rite. It is the cheapest available answer to how an elemental body persists, and it means the population's continuity runs by fission rather than descent - which is why nobody in the setting can produce a cinderkin genealogy, why the offices that certify breakthroughs have no column for one, and why a cinderkin who separates has created a second practitioner rather than a child.

Voreth is the first body on record to do it deliberately and to remain, afterwards, one person with a responsibility. He took the fourteenth rung on the mind ladder, where the qiao vessels open and the sea deepens past the point where the cost curve is still behind the work. That rung's own description is that severing is a mind gate before it is a body one - the self is separated from a specific attachment rather than a limb - and his attachment was the other one. So the setting now contains one registered entry for him and two bodies that could be entered under it. The office that certifies breakthroughs by a body the tier is not licensed to produce has no procedure for that, because the procedure assumes a one-to-one relation between a practitioner and the frame that certifies him, and a cinderkin breaks that assumption by existing rather than by doing anything.

The pairing is exact and neither half of it is optional. His advantage is real and it is not available to anybody else: when an elemental body would be destroyed, his kind continues, and it continues twice. His cost is the same arrangement read from the other side. Nothing is stored, so nothing is lost - and nothing is stored also means nothing of his is continuous, including the thing a genealogy would be made of, including the part of him that separated, and including him. He is the most durable and least persistent thing in the setting at once.

His species has no ceiling to speak of, which is not the same as having no ladder. The authored position is that a cinderkin's qi has no organ to sit in - the fire is the body, so qi passes through it continuously instead of being stored - and every gate that asks for storage is answered instantly and none of them can refuse. There is no gate to fail and no gate to stop at, but there is a ladder, and he is on it, and he is fourteen rungs up it by the only method available to a body that cannot be cut into pieces without consequence.
history: First held a boundary for eleven years without separating from it, and lost the smaller lane in a fuel store fire that was not his fault and that he still describes as his, in the passive voice, every time.

Separated under that pressure, deliberately, with the store's own floor as the fuel, and the smaller spark took and reconstituted. He has never established whether that was a decision or an outcome, and has stopped trying to establish it.

Waited four years for the office that certifies breakthroughs on this tier to say what it intended to do with two bodies and one entry. It sent a form. He filled it in twice, on separate lines, and returned it.
Cleared the rung where the qiao open, on the strength of the separation, on the argument that a discipline is proved by what it can separate from and not by what it can survive.
Refused, in writing, to be used as a demonstration, and paid for the refusal by becoming the only elemental body on this ground that no demonstration has been made of.

personality.summary: Careful, unsentimental, and privately the most responsible person in the setting at a job nobody elected him to. He has separated himself from himself once and the second half of him is alive, and he has organised his entire life around the fact that this was a decision and not an accident.
traits: states which of the two of him is speaking before he says anything worth acting on, and nobody has ever taught him to
will not let a spark of his own be used as fuel for a room, and has refused the request more than once in writing
keeps a place where he separates that he returns to every time, and has never once used a different one
checks on the other one at the same hour daily and has never arranged to meet it, because meeting would imply one of them had chosen
answers a question about what he is with the mechanism and not with a name, and does not notice that nobody asked for a name
mannerisms: touches the boundary at his own flank before he agrees to anything, the way another person would check a lock
speaks in short sentences when he is near fuel and long ones when he is not, and does not know he does it
goes quiet for the length of a decision and does not fill the gap
stands with his silhouette squared even when he is being ignored, because an uneven lane is the only thing about him that can actually be lost
motivations: to be entered in a register as one body with two names on it, or not at all, and he will take either answer over being entered twice
to establish that separation is a discipline rather than an injury, while the only evidence he has is himself
to find out whether the second one would have separated too, and to be honest with himself that he does not want the answer
to stop being useful as an exhibit and start being entered as a practitioner
flaws: treats his own tolerance as unlimited and has no basis for it beyond the fact that nothing has gone wrong yet
cannot imagine the other one's interior, and describes it by subtraction, which is a habit he despises in other readers
assumes every office would rather not know, which is usually true and is therefore his worst habit dressed as experience
will not accept a second separation and has never tested whether he could, which means his one discipline rests on an untested claim about himself
personality.voice: Flat, technical, and quietly funny in a way that arrives about a sentence after the moment that invited it. Says mechanism where other people say feeling, and has been told this is cold and has decided the correction was about them.
taboos: will not be asked to separate again as a demonstration
will not discuss the moment of the split in the first person
will not take a seat in a room whose fuel he cannot identify
will not answer for the other one, about anything, ever

relationships.note: the rung he is on, and the one thing he cannot describe, because describing a separation accurately is the whole of the skill and there is no vocabulary for it that does not sound like a death
the office that certifies a breakthrough by a body the tier is not licensed to produce, and which has one entry for him and two bodies to attach it to
the species his body destroyed once without distinguishing glass from any other fuel; it is the reason an elemental body needs a slot in the law before it is allowed to exist at all
the priesthood whose certification decides who is sound enough to attempt a gate, and whose own rite seals a socket exactly once, which is the same limit he lives inside
the tier cannot produce him and cannot stop producing him; the whole of his standing is that condition, and no office here has agreed what to call it
the population whose fuel was its own body is the one the register cannot agree about, and he is the only member of that population still able to be asked

reference_stats.summary: Reads as a fuel-man with a ledger habit and no standing at all. His advantage is that he can become two bodies and stay one practitioner; the price is that every office in the setting has to choose which of him to enter, and none of them has yet.
strengths: the only body on record that can separate from itself and have both halves continue, which makes him the setting's only demonstrable answer to the question of whether an elemental body persists
nothing can be stored in him and therefore nothing can be stolen from him, so no theft of a cultivation is possible against him and no theft is even attempted
reads a room as temperature, fuel and flow before anybody has spoken, which is not perception as the setting uses the word but is a genuinely separate channel
cleared a rung the ordinary ladder prices by separation, and paid it with an attachment rather than a limb
weaknesses: water is fatal in any sustained volume, so the half of the setting that is wet is closed to him absolutely rather than expensively
a dispersal under pressure leaves him smaller, and there is no practice that grows him back, because nothing about his body is being renewed
he cannot be examined without perturbing the thing examined, so every figure anyone has about him is a figure about an act
the body path is closed to his species outright - an attempt disperses rather than fails - so the whole of his advancement is on one ladder
reference_stats.combat_read: Does not close distance and does not trade. He establishes a fuel gradient and waits, because the fight he can win is the one where the room runs out of something before he runs out of shape. Against a water discipline he is finished at the first splash; against anything that burns he is at his best and his worst in the same stance. A pushed cinderkin is a smaller cinderkin, so any exchange that applies force buys him less than it costs them.
reference_stats.notes: Every pairing here is anatomical or institutional and is quoted from the bible's own species and technique records: the fission under pressure, the closed body path, the absent seat, the death by sustained water, the no-repair consequence, and the separation of the self from a specific attachment rather than a limb. Nothing in this block invents a rule. The one place a mechanical question came up - whether a separation can be repeated - the species record says only that pressure produces fission, so the character is written as untested rather than as capable, and the record says so out loud rather than resolving it.

identity.realm: Seventeenth rung of the mind ladder, Spirit Sovereign, and also the exact ceiling of her species - the first gate demanding both flank vessels pressurised at once, which a body carrying its winter as fat can manage for a few weeks in summer and not for the rest of the year. Her authored ceiling is the seventeenth because of anatomy, not because of a wall, and the seventeenth is the first rung where nothing above reopens the network.

canon.role_in_story: The one body in the setting that can hold a practitioner's frame open around them while they do something neither of them could survive alone, and the only longwinter who has held the seventeenth gate across two consecutive summers. Her species packs a winter as body fat rather than as qi, which makes her a year of usable reserve standing still and waiting to be spent, and whose flank vessels need two warm gradients held at once - a thing her frame can manage for a few weeks a year and then not again for eleven months. So the service she performs has a season, and the season is the whole of her profession. She is not a reader, an assessor, a clerk or a teacher. She is a door that opens twice a year, and what she is being asked to open it for is the one thing in this setting that cannot be done on credit.
canon.first_appearance: First seen walking out of a cold room in the summer weeks with her coat open and both hands empty, telling somebody that it had worked and that she would need the low ground back in the autumn.
canon.lore:
A longwinter survives its winter by storing it. That single decision - pack a winter as body fat rather than as qi - is what everything else about this species is, including the thing that makes her the only person anybody can ask. She carries a year of usable reserve already built and already paid for. The qi in her accumulates rather than circulates, so her breakthroughs come late and, in the record's own word, rarely fail. Her soul is held very deep and very quiet, which makes it difficult to read and exceptionally hard to damage. Her frame is broad, low, heavy and slow, designed for warmth and not for speed.

The cost of that design is a ceiling, and the ceiling is seventeen. The seventeenth is the first gate requiring both flank vessels pressurised at once, and those vessels need two warm gradients held simultaneously. This body can manage that for a few weeks in summer, because a summer produces two warm gradients, and then not again for a year. So the species reaches the seventeenth and loses it every winter thereafter, and the record is explicit that a warm decade is a catastrophe rather than a merely bad year. A longwinter at seventeen is a body standing in a door that closes for eleven months.

She is at that door. She has been at it for a decade, and she is the only longwinter in the setting who has held the seventeenth across two consecutive summers, which makes her the only body here that can hold a frame open around somebody else while they do something neither of them could survive alone. The rung she offers them is the seventeenth on the mind ladder, Spirit Sovereign, and that rung's own record is the sentence the whole arrangement turns on: nothing above it reopens the network, so every deeper gate adds depth to a sea inside a closed body. She is not giving them a technique. She is giving them a closed body to deepen a sea inside, and the closing is the service.

That is the whole of the pairing and both halves are authored. The advantage is real and available to nobody else: she is a year of reserve standing still while somebody else's work is done. The cost is the same reserve, drawn from, twice a year, in the only months when the frame can hold at all - and a longwinter in torpor is a large warm immobile target that cannot be woken quickly, which is what she is for the other eleven months, with a second body inside her.

The sect she works beside holds that a vacant seat is a mechanical fact and that a slot cannot hold what does not exist, and it will not perform a rite at all on the grounds that blessing one is a comfort sold to the anxious. It holds, and it is right to, that the world does not lend capacity. She is the standing exception, and the household that names a seat and never takes it is the reason her summer weeks have anybody in them at all. Neither side has ever proposed that the arrangement be called what it is, because naming it would make it a trade, and a trade can be declined.
history: Stored her first winter alone at nine, badly, and lost most of it, and has eaten defensively ever since without ever once describing herself as frightened.

Held the seventeenth for the first time at thirty-four, for eleven days, alone, and went into the cold immediately afterwards rather than celebrate, which her household read as prudence and she read as arithmetic.

Was asked, by a household that names a seat and never takes it, to hold the frame open for a young practitioner through a gate, and said yes in one word, and did not ask what it would cost her because she had already worked it out.
Held it again the next summer, and the summer after, and on the third attempt came out of the cold a season short of what the store had been before, and told nobody the figure.
Began keeping a written account of what she has handed over, in a hand that gets worse as the page goes on, and has never once shown it to the household it is for.

personality.summary: Enormously patient, physically warm, and privately aware that the most useful thing about her is a limitation. She gives away more than she keeps every year and has stopped keeping a balance, because a balance is a thing you keep and she does not.
traits: asks for what she needs in the same flat tone she uses for weather, and has never once asked twice
counts aloud when she is eating and is embarrassed about it and has not stopped
will not describe herself as carrying anybody, on the grounds that carrying is a word for a service and a service is something you can decline
turns down work she could do, routinely, in favour of work she can hold the whole shape of
is better company at the fourteenth month than the first, which is a species fact and which surprises everybody who meets her in August

motivations: to get through one more window with the second one intact, and to stop calling it that
to be permitted to choose what she carries rather than what she can carry
to find a summer long enough to prove the flank vessels can both be held, since the species record says a few weeks and nobody has established how few
to be a person who is good at something rather than a body that is good at storing
flaws: cannot refuse an ask, only an offer, which means she is always the one who was not asked
measures her worth in what she has handed over and has no measure at all for what she has kept
treats her own tolerance as free, in a species whose tolerance is precisely the store she is spending
believes her ceiling is an inconvenience and has never once described it as the reason she is the only one who can do this
personality.voice: Slow, warm, and much funnier than the slowness suggests. Says the practical sentence first and the true one second, and does not notice the gap between them until somebody else fills it.

will not go into the cold twice in one season
will not wake anybody she put to sleep

canon.role_in_story: The only body in the setting that has gone past the twenty-ninth rung of the mind ladder, and the person who paid for it with the one thing an emberblood cannot give back. An emberblood's fire affinity is structural, its term is fifty years, and its mind path closes the moment the furnace is lit - so every practitioner of this species has to decide once between being fast and being able to go on. She lit hers late, for speed, and reached the thirtieth, which the cultivation record states is the top of the authored ladder and explicitly not the end of what a sea can hold. She is therefore simultaneously the fastest practitioner in the record and a woman who has no door left to open, in a setting whose whole economy prices higher rungs by period because a short-lived body is a lease rather than a purchase. She does not read, certify or teach. She is the answer to a question somebody needs the ladder to have stopped asking.

canon.lore:
An emberblood is a body that runs hot and short. It refines qi faster than anything on this ground and reads intent at the speed of a struck match, at the cost of a lifespan measured in decades rather than centuries. Fire affinity in this species is structural, not a gift: it is in the frame, not in the practice. And the third fact about the species is the one that decided this life: the mind path closes the moment the furnace is lit.

That is not a warning. It is arithmetic. Every emberblood has to decide, once, whether to be fast or to be able to go on, and there is no schedule that lets you have both, because the door is a fire and the fire is in the body. She lit it. She did it late, in the last years a fifty-year term allows, and she did it in order to go further in the time she had, and the door closed behind her with the practice on the far side of it, which means the discipline she is best at is now the one discipline she cannot teach anybody. She is the standing example of the choice working. She is also its finished product.

She went further than the species has a name for. The thirtieth rung of the mind ladder is the top of the authored record, and its own entry says plainly that thirty is a content decision rather than an argument that a thirty-first could not exist, and that what stops there is the number written down and not the sea's capacity. She is at that number. She is the only body in the setting that has gone past the twenty-ninth, and that fact is politically expensive in a way she understood before she arrived: the standing question in this world is whether past the thirtieth is a gate or the end of the ladder, nobody has come back from twenty-nine to describe it, and a court whose authority rests on the ladder visibly stopping somewhere has a strong interest in the answer not being findable.

So the advantage is real and it is hers alone. The thirtieth rung is fully legible to her, because the record says it is the only band in which the ladder's own reading can be read all the way through. And the cost is authored on both sides at once. The furnace is closed and cannot be reopened, so nothing she does now escalates; there is no practitioner alive whose technique she cannot answer, and none whose discipline she can pass on. Her advantage and her ceiling are one fire.

There is also the setting's own arithmetic against her, and it is not a rule anyone invented. The emberblood are the population whose term is fifty years, which is why higher tiers in this world are priced by period rather than by weight and every rung above the mortal is a lease rather than a purchase. She bought the thirtieth with the lease. She has the gate and she has about four years of plate left, and the same fire that opened the door is the one that is eating the years.
history: Refined faster than anybody in her household and was asked at seventeen whether she intended to be fast or to be able to go on, and gave the answer that got her the fastest seat available.
Held a seat for a working decade without lighting anything, and was cited by the discipline that taught her the price as its standing proof that the choice might be optional.
Lit the furnace in the winter she turned forty-nine, alone, on the ash of a fan, and taught herself nothing afterwards because there was nothing left to teach from.
Reached the thirtieth rung at fifty, and sat with it alone for a year before telling anybody, because she wanted to be sure the reading was a reading and not a projection.
Went to the register to read her own line aloud once, and then declined to say the rest of it, and has been asked for the rest of it ever since.

canon.role_in_story: The cheapest rung on this tier and the only practitioner in the district whose ground is not where she is. A marshfolk's home is a raft of woven reed, because fertilisation is external and needs standing water and the eggs are carried under the brood pouch until the water comes back - so the ground a marshfolk is raised on is a thing that drifts. She seated the mind path's lowest gate in her first winter, on that mat, in the ordinary way, and the flood has since taken it nine miles downstream and made it somebody's bank edge. A foundation is seated on ground once; it is not a practice and the discipline has no procedure for laying a second one. So the rung she owns and the ground that produced it are in two places, and the office writes a mat rather than a mile. She does not read for anybody, certify anybody, or hold an office. She is the entry gate's cheapest graduate in a district that has mostly not started, and she is the standing proof that the cheapest rung is still a location.
canon.first_appearance: First seen standing on the bank with one foot still in the channel, counting something under her breath and telling a household head that the mat was not theirs, and had not been for two seasons.
canon.lore:
A marshfolk is neither a tidecaller nor a commonborn but the body in between: a wading amphibian lineage that breathes air, nests on floating mats, and exists to occupy ground that is water half the time and land the other half. Fertilisation is external and needs standing water, so conception happens where the body is. The eggs go down on a mat of woven reed and are carried under the brood pouch through the dry season and hatch when the water returns. The ground a marshfolk is born on is a raft, and the raft is not fixed.

Her anatomy closes the middle of the ladder. The three-point stance over splayed toes and a tail-prop never loads a heel, so the two heel vessels cannot form and the fourteenth gate is where the species stops. Her qi pools low and wide in a broad pelvic basin rather than sitting compactly in the chest, which is why she draws out of wet ground efficiently and out of dry ground poorly. Skin desiccates fast out of water, so travel is timed to the flood. And she cannot stand still - which is not a preference but the fact that the stance her species uses has no still version.

That last fact is why her whole ladder is the lowest rung. The mind path in every office and school in this setting is a discipline of sitting, priced in what a body can hold perfectly still while a charge is held and then let go. She has taken the path in the water, and she is at the foundation - the second rung, the entry gate, which the record prices deliberately at the same figure as the refinement below it because an entry gate has no predecessor to be cheaper than. What changes at that rung is the floor of the sea: it holds a little longer between sittings. She has that, and it is all she has.

Here is the pairing, and both halves are authored. The advantage is real: she is the cheapest rung on the tier, on the only ground here with standing shallow water through the dry season, and a beginner can be shown what the ladder is on her before it has cost her or them anything. The cost is the same fact read from underneath. She seated the foundation in her first winter, on the mat she was raised on, knee-deep, in the ordinary way. The margin is re-made every flood. The mat has gone nine miles downstream and is somebody else's bank edge now, and a foundation is seated on ground once - it is not a practice, and the discipline has no procedure for laying a second one.

So her rung and the ground that produced it are in two places, and the office that would enter her advancement writes a mat and not a mile. Nobody has cheated her and there is nobody to appeal to, because the thing that moved is a flood. The setting's own standing puzzle is larger and of exactly the same shape: a population crossed the stair and neither arrived nor sent word, so the fee is still held and the crossing has no end. She is that shape at one mat, and she would rather be told it than be called an exception.
history: Seated the foundation at nineteen, knee-deep on the mat she was raised on, in a sitting that took two nights and which she describes without pride as the only one she has ever finished.
Taught a younger sibling to sit the entry gate in the water, badly, and has never been able to teach it any other way because there is no posture for it that this body can hold.
Went up to the bank to be counted with the household in the following spring and was entered against a mat and not a mile, which nobody had thought about and which she did not raise either.
Came back after the flood to find the mat she had seated on beached two channels over and already cut into somebody's bank edge, and sat down on it and did not practise.
Asked the assembly for the office's position on a drifted ground in writing, and was told the question was about the office's own form, and did not ask it a second time.

reference_stats.combat_read: Cannot hold a line and knows it. She wins by never being where the strike lands twice, using the current to keep moving and the fact that an amphibian in water is faster than anything on the bank, and she loses the moment the fight is on dry ground. She will not engage on a bank and has never been asked to twice.
reference_stats.notes: Every pairing here is anatomical or institutional and comes from the marshfolk record and the foundation rung: the floating mats, the woven reed, the three-point stance and the heel, the fourteenth gate, the desiccating skin and the flood-timed travel, the low and wide qi pool, the margin as the only wet ground and the fact that it is re-made every flood, and the rung's own statement that an entry gate is priced as the rung below because it has no predecessor. Nothing here invents a rule. The one thing the pair raises that the bible does not settle - whether a foundation can be re-seated on new ground - is left unsettled on purpose, and the character is written to refuse the question rather than to resolve it.

canon.role_in_story: The only body in the setting level on the body ladder and the mind ladder at the same rung, and therefore the only person here the dual page opens for at all - the passive that keeps the body's repair budget and the mind's attention in a single reserve is a claim that two ladders share one reservoir, and it is unreachable for anyone reading one path. His species' authored ceiling is the eleventh rung, set by a brine sac that runs the length of the spine and splits a vessel in half, so the one page in the codex that fits him exactly is the one that asks him to stand where his own body stops. Standing in his dominion is a depth; the register that records it is written in weight and name; his species is the least mobile people in the setting. So the only part of his cultivation that can leave him is the part that has no depth, and there is no column for it. He is a man who can carry two disciplines and cannot be written down carrying either.

canon.lore:
A saltfolk is a people built for brine no softer body could drink. Their kidneys concentrate salt past the point at which ordinary water is poison, which lets them live where the supply never fails and everything else dies back. The price is total dependence: a saltfolk carried onto fresh ground is already dying, and no cultivation repairs it. They fail above the brine line within about nine days, and rain is a hazard rather than a blessing - a saltfolk caught in a downpour is functionally drowning. They are, as their own record puts it, the least mobile people here.

The anatomy sets their ceiling at eleven. A brine sac runs dorsal to the sternum the length of the spine and splits the penetrating vessel into two halves that cannot be joined. They clear the du and ren vessels one at a time and stall at the chong. The soul seats high in the chest precisely to keep it clear of that sac, which is why the organ the ceiling is a wall in does not touch the thing the mind discipline actually works on. Their diet is the mineral crust itself, ground with flat teeth, and their eyes are poor against glare while their tongue reads four orders of dilution in brine - so the most valuable instrument on any basin is a saltfolk's mouth, and the most expensive body to move is the same one.

What he is doing here is on both ladders at once. The technique that keeps the body's repair budget and the mind's attention in one reserve is the most conservative dual entry in the codex, and its own condition is that the page only opens for a practitioner already level on both ladders at the same rung - which is why a single-reading build cannot price it at all and why almost nobody in this setting can even read what it would do. He is level on both. He holds them in one reserve. He is also stopped at the eleventh rung by a sac he cannot get round and has been for most of his adult life, so the one page that fits him exactly is the one whose requirement he satisfies at the same number as his own ceiling.

So the advantage is real: he is the only person on this basin who can spend one reserve on repair and on attention at once, which is the difference between a body that heals and a mind that clears in the same hour. The cost is authored and it is the same reserve counted twice. Two ladders draw from one store, the store is finite, and his species' sac makes the eleventh gate a wall at exactly the rung where the technique asks him to be on both. Everything above eleven is somebody else's arithmetic and his ceiling is anatomy.

The institutional half is worse than the anatomical half and it is not anybody's fault. Standing in the salt dominion is a depth: a household may moor at a depth, that depth is held as an inheritance, and the register that records it is written in weight and name. He is filed under a culture that pooled liability by presence precisely because it concluded its own arithmetic was the greater hazard, and that culture has never had a column for a claim that is portable and no appetite to invent one. He is the least mobile practitioner in the setting and the only part of his practice that could travel is the part that has no depth - so the one thing nobody can enter is the one thing he could carry to a place where it would be worth entering. He has not asked for a different column, because asking would be a proposal.
history: Was entered on the dominion's roll at nine against a depth he was too young to reach and stayed there for sixty years, which is what the roll is for.
Took the body ladder first because a saltfolk of his household could not be sent anywhere, and reached the eleventh in a single year and has been at that number ever since.
Took the mind ladder at fifty-four, on the argument that a discipline nobody in the family had was cheaper than another body gate, and found the sea had no reservoir behind it and would not widen.
Found the dual page in the codex at sixty, having read that it existed and not having known it was openable, and held both ladders to the same rung for six years before it took.
Discovered at sixty-five that the roll had no line for a portable claim, copied his own standing onto the weight board beside it, and told nobody, which is the entry nobody can find.

personality.summary: Flat, courteous, and entirely without self-regard in a way that reads as modesty until you notice that the modesty is carrying the weight. He is the only body here who can hold both ladders at the same rung and he is a man with no line in his own register.

reference_stats.summary: Reads as a slow, careful man who tastes things for a living. He is level on the body ladder and the mind ladder at the same rung, so the one passive that keeps both readings in a single reserve is his; the price is that his species' ceiling is the eleventh rung and the dominion's register indexes standing by a depth, and the only part of his practice that can leave him is the part that has no depth.
strengths: reads brine concentration across four orders of dilution, which in this setting is the whole of the only supply that matters and is worth more to a basin than any advancement on either ladder

the dual technique opens for him at all, and it opens for almost nobody: a shared reserve between the body's repair budget and the mind's attention is the claim that two ladders are one reservoir, and it requires the same rung on both
his soul seats high in the chest specifically to keep it clear of the brine sac, so the organ his ceiling is a wall in does not touch the thing his discipline works on

his ceiling is the eleventh rung and it is the chong, because the sac runs dorsal to the sternum the length of the spine and splits the penetrating vessel into two halves that cannot be joined, and the reservoir channels are the structural defect that sets it

reference_stats.combat_read: Cannot close and does not try. He wins by knowing exactly what a given body can and cannot take, which in a basin where the water is the weapon is most of the fight, and by standing between a thing and the people drinking from it. He has no second line: on ground his body cannot survive he is not a diminished fighter, he is a corpse on a schedule.
